purpose: Registry of architectural benchmarks and integration blueprints for the research-harness. These are NOT runtime tools — they are reference foundations an agent studies to design/upgrade the corresponding harness subsystem. For active callable runtime tools, see the `skills/` layer (src/harness/tools/, registry, MCP built-ins).

distinction.skills/: Active, callable runtime tools invoked by the agent loop at run time (web_search, fetch_url, academic_search, compute, MCP built-ins, etc.).
distinction.references/: Architectural reference foundations — external projects studied as benchmarks/blueprints when designing or upgrading a subsystem. Never imported or called at runtime.

product_identity.kind: autonomous academic/deep-research engine (not a conversational chatbot)
capabilities: Ingesting and converting live web content into LLM-ready clean markdown
Generating synthesized, research-grade responses with verified inline citations and clickable anchor hyperlinks
Reactive UI text inspection — highlighting a phrase/term triggers an anchored definition or deeper contextual breakdown

research_engine_harness.name: Perplexica
research_engine_harness.architectural_pattern: Multi-query search generation, vector re-ranking, and prompt-level inline citation hyperlinking.

content_extraction.name: Crawl4AI
content_extraction.architectural_pattern: Async Playwright crawler, noise stripping (banners/footers), structured markdown extraction, and raw link harvesting.

search_retrieval_backend.name: SearXNG
search_retrieval_backend.architectural_pattern: Zero-cost, unmetered JSON aggregation across 70+ search engines (academic, general web, code).

standardized_tooling_protocol.name: MCP Reference Servers
standardized_tooling_protocol.architectural_pattern: Standardized local STDIO/SSE tool interfaces, specifically mcp-server-fetch for chunked markdown web extraction.

selection_anchor_engine.name: Floating UI
selection_anchor_engine.role: Dynamic Viewport Positioning for Highlight Popovers
selection_anchor_engine.architectural_pattern: Virtual coordinate positioning via window.getSelection() and collision-aware tooltip boundary management.

interactive_text_document.name: Tiptap
interactive_text_document.role: Rich Interactive Text Nodes & Selection Listeners
interactive_text_document.architectural_pattern: ProseMirror-based interactive node views, BubbleMenu for selection triggers, and rich citation metadata nodes.
